scope: New distributionally robust direct-payoff study after the earlier candidate failed a rounds regression guard. Original46101/46102results remain unchanged; no reuse for fitting or promotion.
program_space: Wolf-vote decision tree only, same12predicates and12selectors; all otherB0behavior fixed. Canonical exhaustive first screen:12unconditional selectors plus11predicates times132unequal leafpairs=1464programs.
objective: minimum of mean paired wolf gains across strictRT andstrictRounds minus0.5times mean negative background/timing gain. Ties prefer fewer nonbase leaves, then lexicographic genes. No timing-mode or opponent-name dispatch in policy inputs.

training.stage1: 3wolf deals per background, both timings, every canonical program
training.stage2: best96plusB0 on12wolf deals per background, both timings; cached exact repeats counted once

selection.rule: choose best fixed objective only if both timing mean gains positive; else B0

development.compare: B0 versus one frozen selected program; no further edits

additional_registered_confirmation.only_if: both development timing overall gains>=2pp and unchanged prespecified regression checks pass

claim_limit: A screening optimum over a limited program language/sample is not a global strategy optimum. Incomplete confirmation stays exploratory. No entry/runtime changes or public-repository push.
